title: 課程目錄頁 → 真實 API 串接 (前端)
acceptance: Replace inline mock getCourses() with fetch('/api/courses?locale=' + locale + '&category=' + filter) in page server component
Search input filters courses by title/description client-side on keyup
Category filter dropdown (All Categories / CPD / Compliance / Management) updates query param and re-fetches
CPD Hours range filter (min/max inputs) passes to API query params
Loading skeleton shown while course list is fetched
Empty state message when no courses match filters (from dict.courseView.emptyState)

Pagination or 'Load More' if result count exceeds page size
Error state: if API fetch fails, show retry button
files: src/components/courses/CoursesView.tsx (rewrite — loading/empty/error states, category/CPD re-fetch, Load More)
src/components/courses/CourseList.tsx (rewrite — skeleton cards, error+retry, Load More button)
